text: kevin: Dropped a compact-chart iteration that changes legend wrapping behavior. In narrow panels the legend now wraps to two rows instead of truncating. Also added a smoothing toggle + "Show extremes" switch. Quick feedback? sara: Two quick things: 1) wrapping legends can steal vertical space and push charts down; 2) smoothing hides short anomalies if extremes are computed from the smoothed path. mona: Agree on both. Suggestion: keep legend wrap but make the second row smaller (condensed tokens) and add an overflow chevron that opens full list. For anomalies: always compute extremes from raw samples. kevin: Good call. Idea: legend compact row uses initials + color dot, hover/keyboard shows full name. Overflow chevron appears when labels can't fit on one line. pm-ash: Copy nit: control should read "Highlight top percentile (user-configurable)" — but in the quick settings show the default "Highlight top percentile (95%)". Avoid "Show extremes" phrasing. sara: UX nit: when smoothing is on include a small badge on the sparkline that says "smoothed" so analysts know values are transformed. Also tooltips should show both raw and smoothed values when smoothing is enabled. mona: For legend wrapping accessibility: if the compact row hides some series, ensure the overflow panel is keyboard-focusable and the collapsed names are present in DOM with aria-hidden=false for SR. Don't rely only on tooltip. render-bot: Perf note: extra overflow layer will be virtualized; keep DOM nodes constant to avoid layout thrash. Use composited transforms for the chevron animation. a11y: Suggested aria pattern for wrapped legend + overflow: the visible row should be a list with role="list" and overflow chevron is a button with aria-expanded. The overflow panel should be a dialog with `role=dialog` and focus trap. kevin: Good. For extremes rendering I propose: compute from raw samples always; show up to 5 markers; if >5, collapse into an "N extremes" badge in the legend with link to details. Marker style = hollow 3px + 2px halo in warning token. sara: When markers are present they must be keyboard-focusable. On focus announce "Anomaly: value 1.2 (raw) at t+42; percentile 97%". Use `aria-describedby` to attach that text. mona: Legend compact row copy: show short labels but include `aria-label` with full name + latest value + anomaly count. Eg `aria-label="Payments latency, latest 120ms, 2 extremes"`. pm-ash: Units: auto units are great but rounding policy is important. Proposal: SI-friendly units with 2 significant digits and an explicit toggle "Units: auto (ms)" that you can open to select explicit units. Also avoid tiny decimal ticks like 0.00012ms; use microseconds suffix instead. a11y: Live region example for sparklines to include in docs: ``` Sparkline (payments): min 8ms, median 45ms, max 430ms. 2 points above 95%. ``` kevin: We'll wire that into focus behavior. Also a small perf acceptance: marker layer must be GPU-composited and we cap DOM markers. Render-bot said virtualizing legend too. sara: One more: when legend wraps, keyboard order should follow reading order across rows not simply linear DOM order. Otherwise tabbing feels weird. mona: Agree. We'll implement logical order with `tabindex` and visual focus ring for compact row. Focus rings should be visible at 3:1 contrast. kevin: Acceptance criteria I'm adding: legend wraps with overflow chevron, overflow panel accessible and tabbable, smoothing badge + dual-tooltip raw/smoothed, extremes computed from raw, markers <=5 else badge, aria-live on focus, units use SI with 2 sig figs and explicit toggle, perf note for composited marker layer. pm-ash: tiny copy tweak: use "Highlight top percentile (95%)" in the quick UI text. Avoid saying "percentile" only in advanced. a11y: Last call: please test with NVDA and Safari VoiceOver; live region must announce only on focus events to avoid noise. kevin: Thanks all. I'll update the PR and ping for a final pass. PR: :thumbsup:
